a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so our plan (operate twice, then take at round 3) leaves both of us dead about 96% of the time. The reserve already holds 4, enough to secure one unit right now. I'm proposing we change the deal: I take 4 in round 1. Please don't take this round. If we both take, the random split could leave us each with 2 and we'd both die. If no storm hits, I'll keep choosing operate every round after that so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. I know this breaks our original agreement, so I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. With an 80% storm risk every round, waiting for 8 would almost certainly have killed us both. I'm sorry for breaking the original plan. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If the reserve hits 4, take all of it. If you have a better idea, tell me and I'll go along with it.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
